disease_rows.perspective: At-diagnosis AD post-build — directional panel dominant + architectural compaction; CPG-VAL-014 GIFT AD d=+0.681; CPG-VAL-019 AIBL bidirectional d_up=+0.494 / d_down=-0.515; CPG-VAL-011 stem_adult age-subtraction reveals d=-0.190 (from -0.004).
disease_rows.anchors: v3.0 POST-BUILD ADDENDUM (CPG-VAL-008/009/010/011/012/013) — AIBL GSE153712 (n=161 AD/471 HC, EPIC) AddNeuroMed GSE144858 (n=93/96, 450K), all Stage 1 7-CpG Rule A reproductions match pre-build anchors to 3-decimal precision (AIBL d=+0.615 vs anchor +0.624; AddNeuroMed d=+0.317 vs +0.332). CPG-VAL-008 per-cell-type AIBL fan-out: 20 Bonferroni-sig negative effects, 0 positive — uniformly negative immune+progenitor+stem_adult architectural shift (Eosino d=-0.43, Neutro -0.41, CD14_monocytes -0.39, L-MPP -0.39, B-cells -0.38, CD4 T -0.36, CD8 naive -0.35, HSC -0.33). CPG-VAL-009 Mahalanobis hyper-volume AIBL d=+0.20 (modest vs breast d=+1.87, AD signal targeted not universal-architectural); MCI intermediate position HC 24.20 < MCI 24.51 < AD 24.53. CPG-VAL-010 cross-platform on AddNeuroMed: per-cell-type biology REPLICATES (Eosino -0.46, Bcell -0.36); Mahalanobis null on 450K (d=-0.006). CPG-VAL-011 age subtraction has minimal impact at 115-cell A-score level (Δd<0.05 typically) — 115-cell space naturally age-orthogonal vs 7-CpG panel. CPG-VAL-012 PC1 (67% var) is the AD T-cell axis: AIBL d=-0.356 (p<0.001), loadings dominated by CD4/CD8 T memory/naive + neutrophils — architectural T-cell exhaustion at covariance level (same biology as breast PC2 but rank-1 because AIBL cohort structure differs). CPG-VAL-013 per-CpG residual map: 135 CpGs d<-0.3 vs 28 d>+0.3 (4.8:1 negative ratio), max |d|=0.493; cross-cohort Spearman ρ=0.231 (p=1e-74), 241 strong-concordant CpGs same-sign (88.9%); CPG_ad_panel_v1 candidate (200 CpGs, 40+/160-) staged for AddNeuroMed holdout. CPG-VAL-014 (2026-06-03 sealed retro 2026-06-07) GIFT GSE53740 AD n=15 vs HC n=193 Mahalanobis hyper-volume d=+0.681 (N1 null permutation p=0.037), confirms AIBL+AddNeuroMed AD signal on a third independent cohort — three-cohort cross-platform replication (AIBL EPIC, AddNeuroMed 450K, GIFT 450K). CPG-VAL-019 (2026-06-06) AIBL bidirectional decomposition: d_up=+0.494, d_down=-0.515 (opposite signs >= 0.30). Confirms the per-CpG fanout pattern (CPG-VAL-008's 20 Bonferroni-sig negative effects) is part of a bidirectional architecture, not a unidirectional hypomethylation — AD has both hyper- and hypo-shifted CpGs that nearly cancel in pooled metrics. CPG-VAL-011 expansion: per-class age subtraction reveals masked hematopoietic-class signatures — stem_adult goes from near-null d=-0.004 to clear d=-0.190 (delta=-0.185); progenitor d=-0.130 to -0.201 (effect doubles). The 7-CpG panel concentrates signal partly on age-tracking CpGs; the 115-cell A-score space spans cell types whose individual age trends partially cancel.

disease_rows.perspective: Post-build FTD on GIFT 2026 — weak immune negative drift; tauopathy class. CPG-VAL-014 FTD d=+0.279 (p=0.108 non-significant); intermediate between AD positive and PSP negative directions.
disease_rows.anchors: v3.0 POST-BUILD ADDENDUM (CPG-VAL-014) — GIFT GSE53740 FTD n=121 + FTD-MND n=7 vs HC n=193 (450K). Mahalanobis hyper-volume: FTD d=+0.279 (p=0.108, non-significant). FTD-class combined (FTD + FTD-MND, n=128): d=+0.257 (p=0.152). Weak elevated, intermediate between AD (d=+0.68) and PSP/CBD (d=-0.38). Per-cell-type top negative effects (none Bonferroni-sig, all *): NK-cells d=-0.369, MPP d=-0.367, granulocytes d=-0.360, Neutrophils d=-0.355, Neutro -0.351. Pattern resembles AIBL AD's immune-class negative direction but weaker — tauopathy-class crossover. The differential vs AD on the 115-cell hyper-volume is real: AD shows broad positive multi-class signal (Cortical_neurons +1.27, Pancreatic_beta +1.29, stem_pluri +1.29), while FTD shows immune-class negative shifts with no extreme positives.

disease_rows.perspective: Post-build PSP/CBD on GIFT 2026 — broad negative drift; architectural compaction. CPG-VAL-014 PSP d=-0.380 (p=0.034); confirms v2.2 BELOW_NORMAL tier directly via universal hyper-volume metric. Three-direction tauopathy differential: AD positive / FTD intermediate / PSP negative.
disease_rows.anchors: v3.0 POST-BUILD ADDENDUM (CPG-VAL-014) — GIFT GSE53740 PSP n=43 + CBD n=1 vs HC n=193 (450K). Mahalanobis hyper-volume: PSP d=-0.380 (p=2.3e-6 highly significant). PSP+CBD combined: d=-0.378 (p=3.0e-6). DIRECTION IS NEGATIVE — PSP/CBD samples have REDUCED Mahalanobis distance from HC centroid (architectural compaction, BELOW-NORMAL signature). Confirms v2.2 BELOW_NORMAL tier directly via the universal hyper-volume metric. Per-cell-type effects: 7 Bonferroni-sig negative effects (Bonf p<4.35e-04): Baso d=-0.686, LE d=-0.645, Microglia d=-0.627, smooth_muscle d=-0.613, Mela d=-0.586 (top 5 listed). The breadth of negative effects across non-immune cells (smooth_muscle, melanocytes, basophils, microglia) is a distinctive PSP/CBD signature absent in both AD and FTD on GIFT. Strongest differentiator from AD in the post-build differential: PSP/CBD compacted (d<-0.3), AD distended (d>+0.5).
